items.title: Bitcoin faces U.S. CPI test as analysts warn inflation relief may not be enough
items.summary: Bitcoin trades below $75,000 ahead of the October inflation data. Analysts warning that sustainable recovery depends on improving liquidity and spot ETF demand rather than temporary macro relief.

items.title: HIVE, MARA mine more Bitcoin but earn less as crypto prices fall
items.summary: Both miners reported higher Bitcoin production but lower mining revenue and rising electricity costs as they expanded their AI infrastructure businesses.

items.title: MARA posts $634 million Q3 net profit on bitcoin gains, sells 13,597 BTC to pay off loans
items.summary: MARA posted a $634.4 million Q3 net profit, then sold 13,597 BTC to repay $750 million in loans as it pivots to AI.

items.summary: According to Fitch Ratings, bitcoin demonstrated growing market resilience following the $6.3 billion Binance hack, falling just 6%–a far milder price decline than those seen during previous crypto crises. items.title: Amundi Boosts Strategy (MSTR) Stake 44% to $291 Million as Shares Slide
items.summary: Europe's largest asset manager raised its Strategy holding to 1.9 million shares in the third quarter, a 13F shows, even as MSTR has since fallen about 18% from quarter-end. This post Amundi Boosts Strategy (MSTR) Stake 44% to $291 Million as Shares Slide first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

items.title: Bitcoin Developer Floats 'Quantum Landmines' to Trap Future BTC Thieves
items.summary: Longtime Bitcoin Core developer Cory Fields has introduced an unconventional defense against future quantum attacks: secretly planted "quantum landmines" that could allow bitcoin holders to reclaim stolen coins while confiscating an attacker's collateral, potentially turning attempted theft into an expensive mistake. items.title: Bitcoin in Limbo as Stocks Rebound Ahead of US Inflation Report
items.summary: U.S. stocks rallied as oil fell, but Bitcoin hovered near $75,000 after a wave of liquidations, with Tuesday's inflation report set to test bets on a December Fed rate hike.

items.title: Bitcoin, tech stocks brush off Nvidia nerves as analyst mulls $68K target
items.summary: Bitcoin rebounded from an 11-week low near $73,500 as the Nasdaq Composite rallied despite sell-off in Nvidia shares.
